_doc: CARD VAULT: level-up cards you unlock by drawing in the vault (gold, then gems, then card tokens). Owned vault cards join the level-up draw in story runs and survivor hours. Vault level (1-5, from duplicate draws) scales the card; picking it again in a run (max 3) adds half again. stat keys: dmg/xp/gold/crit/steam/area/cd/pickup are fractions, speed px, hp flat, heal HP per kill. needs: synergy cards need both listed cards owned + the DECK SYNERGY node; evolution needs the base at vault Lv5 + DECK EVOLUTION.
